notes.title: Sinful Eden 'Panty PaniX' Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/102eD97.png[/img]

Hey guys, after gathering a lot of community feedback it seems many people were finding it difficult to raise their cash & reputation stats within the game, to try and address this I've updated the casino with a new mini-game 'Panty PaniX', which adds a little more variety to gameplay and acts as another option to raise your stats. In this update I've also addressed a few other issues and bugs, full patch details are below.

[h1] New: [/h1] 
•Panty PaniX mini-game
•Windowed mode: You can now enter/exit windowed mode by pressing ALT + Enter
•Exit game: You're now able to exit the game at any time by pressing ALT + F4
•Updated in-game instructions screen

[h1] Fixed: [/h1] 
•Instant time-out bug in the Goddess Board mini-game has been fixed


I hope this update will enhance peoples overall experience with Sinful Eden, I'd also like to thank the community for giving me some helpful feedback, which in turn helps me to make the game better. Thanks guys, and please feel free to follow us on Twitter and YouTube. Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist if it interests you. The links are below:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/DUALHAZE

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPaAIytaWXwO5EOilFEC1bA
